description: Complete SGLang metrics dashboard generated from the PD and Router metric catalogs. The configured data source is intentionally a placeholder.

options.content:
# SGLang PD Unified Metrics

This dashboard covers **122 metric families** for a unified prefill/decode engine. It currently uses the placeholder Prometheus data source `SGLangPlaceholder`, so no live values are expected until that data source URL is replaced. Metrics are lazily registered; feature-gated metrics may still show no data after a real source is connected.
